labs.name: Translation and cross-language mediation: guided
labs.task: Translate a short non-specialist text, review it for meaning and register, and compare with an independent reviewer.
deliverables: One corrected attempt and support log
conditions: Use a verified speaker or recording for listening.
Keep observable performance separate from confidence.

labs.name: Translation and cross-language mediation: transfer
labs.task: Produce a fresh translation and an audience-specific summary, explaining different choices.
deliverables: One corrected attempt and support log
conditions: Use a verified speaker or recording for listening.
Keep observable performance separate from confidence.

questions.prompt: Is translation always the same as summarising?
Does Arabic ability alone prove equal writing competence in the target language?
Explain what must be preserved when translating لم يبدأ المشروع بعد into English.

assessments.task: Answer before revealing keys; try the Arabic application prompt where present, then explain or correct errors. Record independent answers separately from corrections.
pass_criteria: All question responses substantively correct after feedback; preserve the independent first attempt and flag every assisted correction.
assessments.mastery_note: Written knowledge and application checks support only the observed evidence dimensions. They do not establish listening, pronunciation, spontaneous interaction or independent transfer by themselves.
